annotations.title: Journeyed data report on Los Angeles hotels

description: A Journeyed data report about Los Angeles area hotels as a whole: parking (how many hotels state a price, how many are free, typical charges by area), resort fees, pet policies, check-in and checkout times, hotels near stadiums and arenas, and what hotel websites leave out. Returns the headline numbers with their sample sizes, the main findings, the first rows of each table, the method caveats, the page URL and the CSV link. Use it for market-wide statistics, not for one hotel. Call it with no topic to list the reports.

topic.description: Report topic: parking, resort fees, pets, check-in times, venues, what websites leave out. Leave out to list the reports.

name: get_report

method.description: Method and caveats. Read them before quoting a number.

sample.description: Sample sizes: hotels in the market, hotels with a website, sites read, hotels stating the fact.

title: Journeyed data report on Los Angeles hotels
